creator: lulaindee
caption:
This isn’t the most “aesthetic” what I eat in a day - but this is my real life. I unfortunately don’t get to make a lunch from scratch at home everyday like a lot of content creators you might see! My snacks and lunches are spent hunched over my desk while a student comes in needing my help mid-bite lol. I hope this shows you a realistic & balanced day of eating to inspire you to make good food that’ll also make you feel good! My weeks are always better when I meal prep in advance like I did this week ✨

Lunch salad IB: @thecarolinalifestyle

transcript.text: As a school nurse we do get summers off so I enjoyed my time but it is time to get back into the
routine and this is what I eat in a day. I always start every morning with some water and my
morning drink it has L-glutamine, creatine, greens powder and some chlorophyll. I usually have my
breakfast at work and this day I meal preps in breakfast burritos, it had turkey kielbasa, some cheese,
eggs and some black beans. This was so good especially with the Cholula. For a snack I had my crunchy
date snickers which I always have, refill on some water then it was time for lunch. I meal preps
this recipe from the Carolina lifestyle. It has chickpeas, cucumber, edamame, feta, some pesto and
some everything but the bagel seasoning. I also had some grilled chicken that I made on the side
kept working and yes these glasses are just for aesthetic. Okay don't judge me. Got home and had
my pre-workout snack which is sourdough, carried gold butter, some probiotic honey, some kiwi,
and some salt on top. I also had my Celsius. I went for a run this day whoo I was wiped. My son
wanted mac and cheese for dinner so we had goodles, some taco meat on the side and some veggies with
a sparkling water. And of course a sweetie treat. I made this frozen Reese's peanut butter yogurt
cup. Oh my gosh this is so good. Let me know if y'all want the recipe for this. I had my nighttime
vitamins with a liquid IV and I went to bed. Love y'all. Bye.

myVersion.hook: Coaching calls from 9 to 7 and still eating well. Here's my full day, no filter.
myVersion.script:
Coaching calls from 9 to 7 and still eating well. Here's my full day, no filter.
First thing, a big glass of warm water. Then my chai, because I'm not giving that up.
Breakfast is a besan chilla I mixed the batter for on Sunday. Two of them, with curd on the side.
Ten minutes, done before my first call.
Mid-morning I'm on calls back to back, so it's a fruit and a handful of roasted chana from my desk drawer.
Lunch is my dabba. Rajma, a small bowl of rice, kachumber salad.
Not pretty. I ate it between two client check-ins.
That's real life and it still counts.
If your lunch looks this messy too, you're doing fine. Eating it is the win.
Around four the energy dips. Second chai, and a few almonds.
Six thirty, I squeeze in my workout. Today was lower body at home, forty minutes.
Before that, a banana with a spoon of peanut butter so I don't crash halfway.
Dinner is paneer bhurji, two rotis and whatever sabzi Mummy made.
And yes, dessert. A bowl of curd with a bit of jaggery and some crushed nuts. My nightly treat.
Nothing fancy. Nothing I can't repeat tomorrow.
That's the whole secret. Food you can actually keep eating on your busiest day.
